groups.name: core
groups.why: i.MX6ULZ U1 and DDR3 U2 (both seated by fixed_poses) with every decap on their rails (VDD_SOC/ARM/HIGH/SNVS/USB caps, PLL, +3V3 NVCC caps, VMEM caps for both chips' DRAM rails), the DRAM VREF divider R13/R14 with C36/C38-C40, the ZQ resistors R15/R16, the CLK0 termination R1, the supply ferrites FB2/FB3 at the SoC, and the 24 MHz crystal Y1 with its load caps C11/C15. One group so each VMEM cap is matched to whichever chip's VMEM pin is nearest

groups.name: straps
groups.why: BOOT_CFG1/2/4 pull-up/pull-down strap resistors (all on B), each wired only to a U1 BOOT_CFG ball on U1's east face; strap resistors sit at the SoC pins

groups.name: boot_sw
groups.why: SW2 BOOT_CFG1 DIP switch with its +3V3 pull-ups R17/R22/R23/R24 on the switched nets; top-actuated slide DIP, user-set, toward the east edge beside the BOOT_CFG straps

groups.name: reset
groups.why: reset: SW3 push button, LM809 supervisor U7 with its +3V3 decap C16 and RST_DLY pull-down R67, R3 into SOC_RST_L with C17; SOC_ONOFF pull-up R2; boot-mode DIP SW1 with pull-ups R65/R66. All their U1 balls (P8 RST, R8 ONOFF, T10/U10 BOOT_MODE) are on U1's west face

groups.name: power
groups.why: +5V entry header J1, three TLV62568 bucks (U5 +3V3 with L1, U4 +1V2 with L2, U6 VMEM with L3) with their input caps C19/C21/C25/C27, output caps C22/C26/C28, FB dividers R5-R8/R10/R11 and PG pull-ups R4/R9/R12, and the MCP1700 SNVS LDO U8 with C20

groups.name: debug
groups.why: debug/IO connectors whose U1 balls are all on U1's south face: JTAG J2, FTDI UART1 J3 with series R68/R69, UART2 J6 with series R72/R73, I2C2 J7 with pull-ups R70/R71

groups.name: qspi
groups.why: QSPI header J5; its U1 balls (A3/A4/B5/C5/D5/E6) are at U1's north-east corner
